name: expense-tracker-pennywise
description: A secure, full-stack personal finance application built with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js. PennyWise allows users to track expenses, visualize spending patterns through interactive charts, and manage their financial data — all behind a secure JWT-authenticated API.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
